title: Camera scanning out of scope
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 11. Verifying: the same steps upwards. QR Code Generation, 11. Verifying: the same steps upwards: “Confirm the HC1: prefix and strip it.”.

statements.label: Camera scanning out of scope
statements.requirement: Decoding QR images from a camera or file is out of scope for the core libraries. The verifier entry point SHALL be the scanned text (HC1 string) or raw COSE bytes.

successCriteria.criterion: Inspection of the public API finds the verifier's entry points take the HC1 text or COSE bytes, and no image or camera type.
